summary: Operation 'Vivaldi' resulted in the capture of over 250 Russian soldiers, described as a highly successful maneuver. Concurrently, a Russian Tu-95MS strategic bomber with a complete crew and cruise missiles was lost after taking off for relocation. Massive air strikes on Kyiv forced the national university to transition to distance learning as Russian drone and missile activity intensifies.
key_points: Operation 'Vivaldi' resulted in the capture of over 250 Russian soldiers, with battalion-level units shattered and many officers taken prisoner (Source: @DeepStateUA/23866).
A Russian Tu-95MS bomber with a complete crew, likely armed with cruise missiles, took off for relocation to Olenya airfield and was subsequently lost (Source: @eRadarrua/118503).
Ukrainian drone strikes on the land corridor to Crimea destroyed approximately 40 units of Russian military and logistics vehicles in September 2026 (Source: @eRadarrua/118428).
Massive strikes on Kyiv forced Taras Shevchenko National University to switch to distance learning due to the intensity of the attacks (Source: @UkraineNow/84374).
Ukrainian air defenses intercept 57% of jet-powered drones launched by Russia, though further technological improvements are needed (Source: @UkraineNow/84369).
Head of Ukrainian military intelligence Kirill Budanov warned that long-range strikes on Russian territory will become deeper and more powerful (Source: @UkraineNow/84367).
The mining and metallurgical complex in Kryvyi Rih is at a standstill, with major enterprises operating at a maximum of 25% of pre-war production levels (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33589).
Estonia officially accused Russia of organizing an arson attack on the Milrem Robotics defense company in Tallinn in August 2026 (Source: @eRadarrua/118461).

points: Kyiv: Massive Russian air strikes forced Taras Shevchenko National University to switch to distance learning, highlighting the severe impact of attacks on civilian infrastructure (Source: @UkraineNow/84374).

Kryvyi Rih: The city's defense council head stated that the mining and metallurgical complex is collapsing, with Arcelor, Inhulets GOK, Pivdenny GOK, and KZRK at a standstill, while other enterprises operate at maximum 25% capacity (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33589).
National: Ukrainian air defenses intercept 57% of jet-powered drones launched by Russia, with new interception systems actively being tested and refined (Source: @UkraineNow/84369).
Korosten: The city was targeted by a guided Geran-5 missile, indicating continued Russian efforts to strike Ukrainian infrastructure (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75885).

General: MP Sobolev warned that the upcoming winter will be extremely difficult, making it impossible to supply high-rise buildings with electricity and water, urging citizens to relocate to rural areas (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33586).

Strategic Aviation: A Tu-95MS bomber with a complete crew and likely loaded with cruise missiles took off for relocation to Olenya airfield but was subsequently lost, marking a significant operational blow (Source: @eRadarrua/118503).
Kursk Region: A ballistic missile was launched from the Kursk region towards Ukrainian territory, indicating continued offensive capabilities (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75905).
Casualties: Operation 'Vivaldi' resulted in the capture of over 250 Russian soldiers, with battalion-level units shattered and many officers among the prisoners (Source: @DeepStateUA/23866).

Logistics: Ukrainian drones have heavily targeted the land corridor to Crimea, destroying about 40 units of military and logistics equipment, including 37 trucks and two fuel tankers (Source: @eRadarrua/118428).
Estonia: Russia was formally accused by Estonia of organizing an arson attack on Milrem Robotics in Tallinn, a defense company producing THeMIS UGVs used in Ukraine (Source: @eRadarrua/118461).

Dnipropetrovsk Region: A UAV was detected in the eastern part of the region heading in a southwest direction, indicating continued Russian reconnaissance and strike preparations (Source: @kpszsu/81351).
Kryvyi Rih Area: A loitering munition of the 'Banderoval' type was spotted east of Kryvyi Rih heading south, threatening the industrial hub (Source: @kpszsu/81330).

Kryvyi Rih: The city's defense council head reported that the industrial foundation is collapsing, with key metallurgical and mining enterprises at a complete standstill (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33589).

General: Ukrainian intelligence warned that Russian forces may increasingly target medical facilities in addition to logistics nodes, posing a severe humanitarian challenge (Source: @UkraineNow/84363).
Kyiv: A jet-powered UAV was detected north of the capital heading directly towards the city, indicating an active threat (Source: @kpszsu/81396).
Chernihiv Region: A jet-powered UAV was spotted at Sosnytsia heading into the Chernihiv region from the north (Source: @kpszsu/81356).
Chernihiv Region: Another UAV was detected in the western part of the Chernihiv region heading south (Source: @kpszsu/81349).
Zhytomyr Region: A UAV was tracked passing through the Chernobyl exclusion zone heading towards the Zhytomyr region (Source: @kpszsu/81358).
Kyiv Outskirts: Drones continue to circle the outskirts of the capital, with activity also reported in the Zhytomyr region towards Ovruch (Source: @eRadarrua/118496).
Kherson Region: A UAV was detected in the northern part of the Kherson region heading towards the Dnipropetrovsk region and Kryvyi Rih (Source: @kpszsu/81353).

Crimea Corridor: Ukrainian drone strikes on the land corridor to Crimea have resulted in the destruction of approximately 40 vehicles, severely disrupting Russian logistics (Source: @eRadarrua/118428).

Black Sea: Ukrainian Minister of Agrarian Policy Taras Vysotskyi stated that Kiev does not expect a truce in the Black Sea in the coming months, preparing for the current critical situation to persist (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33581).
Strategic Loss: A Russian Tu-95MS bomber with a complete crew and cruise missiles was lost after taking off for relocation to Olenya airfield (Source: @eRadarrua/118503).
Loitering Munitions: Two 'Banderoval' loitering munitions were tracked heading towards the Dnipro region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75921).
Kyiv Air Threat: A jet-powered Shahed drone was detected over the right bank of the capital (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75916).
Korosten Strike: A guided Geran-5 missile was launched towards Korosten, indicating persistent air strike capabilities (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75885).
Interception Rate: Ukraine intercepts 57% of jet-powered drones launched by Russia, with ongoing efforts to improve interception technologies (Source: @UkraineNow/84369).
Strategic Warning: Head of GUR Kirill Budanov warned that Ukrainian long-range strikes on Russian territory will become deeper and more powerful (Source: @UkraineNow/84367).
